shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin spot ETFs experienced $635 million in net outflows, accompanied by $431-455 million in leveraged long liquidations.
Upcoming US Midterm Elections on November 3rd are historically correlated with Bitcoin price declines.
Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade was delayed on the Hoodi testnet due to security risks with smart contracts, with no new mainnet date set.
Fears of a potential Federal Reserve interest rate hike from the October 27-28 meeting are impacting cryptocurrencies.
SoFi introduced 'SOFIE,' enabling bank deposits to be held as on-chain tokens with a 4.40% variable annual interest.
